defs.def: extremely good 优秀的；杰出的；极好的

ex.s: Things like kale ribs, fish collars, rejected sweet potatoes, and cucumber butts were all re-appropriated and, with the help of a number of good chefs, turned into excellent cuisine.
ex.t: 像羽衣甘蓝梗、鱼颈肉、被挑拣出的红薯和黄瓜屁股这类东西，都被重新利用，并在几位好厨师的帮助下，变成了极好的菜肴。

ex.s: He found there were excellent free books.
ex.t: 他发现那里有很棒的免费书。

ex.s: B.The quality of life in France is equally excellent.
ex.t: B. 法国的生活质量同样优秀。

ex.s: You must have an excellent knowledge of office-related software．
This is an excellent fantasy novel from one of the best storytellers around.
ex.t: 这是来自最优秀的讲故事者之一的优秀奇幻小说。

ex.s: 5．（1分）________all the problems， several of the players produced excellent performances．（  ）
ex.t: 5．（1分）________所有这些问题，几名球员还是奉献了出色的表现。（ ）

ex.s: When combined with berries or slices of other fruits, frozen bananas make an excellent base for thick, cooling fruit shakes and low fat “ice cream”.
ex.t: 当与浆果或其他水果片混合时，冷冻香蕉是制作浓稠凉爽的水果奶昔和低脂"冰淇淋"的绝佳基底。

ex.s: Meet the producers and get some excellent recipe ideas.
ex.t: 去见见生产者，并获得一些绝佳的食谱灵感。

ex.s: While famous foreign architects are invited to lead the designs of landmark buildings in China such as the new CCTV tower and the National Center for the Performing Arts, many excellent Chinese architects are making great efforts to take the center stage.
ex.t: 虽然外国著名建筑师受邀主导中国地标性建筑的设计，如新的央视大楼和国家大剧院，但许多优秀的中国建筑师正在努力走向舞台中央。

ex.s: Developed by two doctors in the US Department of Agriculture, it’s an excellent water collector.
ex.t: 它由美国农业部两位医生研发，是一个极佳的集水器。

ex.s: You wouldn’t think that a few    58   (month) of exercise in your teens would be enough    59    the rest of your life, and that’s also true for building your vocabulary—you have to keep at it daily, and pretty soon you will find that you have an excellent vocabulary.
ex.t: 你不会认为青少年时期几个月的锻炼就足以受用余生，积累词汇量也是如此——你必须每天坚持，很快你就会发现自己的词汇量非常出色。

ex.s: Despite a weight of up to 300 kilograms, they can run at a speed of around 64 kilometers per hour and are also excellent swimmers.
ex.t: 尽管体重可达 300 公斤，它们的奔跑速度仍能达到每小时约 64 公里，而且也是出色的游泳者。

ex.s: He is an excellent 7_______ and a great 8________.
ex.t: 他是一位出色的 7_______ 和一位了不起的 8________。

ex.s: She had an excellent heart–her disposition was affectionate, and her feelings were strong; but she knew how to govern them: it was a knowledge which her mother had yet to learn; and which one of her sisters had resolved never to be taught.
ex.t: 她有一颗极好的心——她性情温柔，感情强烈；但她懂得如何控制它们：这是她母亲还未能学会的知识；也是她其中一个妹妹发誓永远不会学的东西。

ex.s: There is no excellent beauty, that hath not some strangeness in the proportion.
ex.t: 没有不带有某种奇异比例之处的绝佳之美。

ex.s: A man cannot tell, whether Apelles, or Albert Durer, were the more trifler: whereof the one would make a personage by geometrical proportions: the other, by taking the best parts out of divers faces, to make one excellent.
ex.t: 谁也说不清阿佩勒斯和阿尔伯特·丢勒谁更无聊：前者试图按几何比例造出一个完美人物；后者则从不同的面孔中挑出最美的部分来合成一张完美的脸。

defs.def: （用以表示愉快或赞同）好极了，妙极了
